cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 gives the share of births registered in the digital system; the SPI's at least 90% (MUS-003, 2024) is a national rate not tied to it.
cells.note: Held at 4, housekeeping 71: MUS-003, the World Bank SPI's 2024 birth registration at least 90% complete, is a national rate, which Bill ruled is not a yes to question 4 (2026-10-25). MUS-001 and MUS-002 show births and deaths compiled from the Civil Status Division's computerised system in 2026.
